storyCards.headline: 2 Legit 2 Quit: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
M.c. Hammer's "2 Legit 2 Quit" reached #5 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #5 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 20 weeks on the chart.

2 Legit 2 Quit was released in 1991.
